---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

The Bond films in this dataset were released from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide revenue of James Bond films by release year."
#| echo: true

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
